[SWS_EM_01067] Finish of a successful state transition
⌈
When all op-
eration required for a state transition has been performed successfully, Execution
Management shall consider the transition to be complete, set the CurrentState to
the RequestedState and report success back to State Management.
⌋

rentState to the RequestedState and report success back to State Manage-
ment.
